items.caption: What is working right now for YOU in terms of sales? #cleaning #smallbusinesssupportingsmallbusiness
items.ownerFullName: Morgan Graffis | Cleaning Business Coach | Hiring & Growth
items.transcript: So my whole goal in life is to make cleaning business owners, specifically women, because predominantly women, let's be honest, more money in their cleaning company. So I want to talk about some things that are working that can make you more money if you're running a cleaning company. So obviously sales is something that you really have to focus on when you want to make more money. If you were to 10X your revenue tomorrow, would you make more money? Okay, so I'm going to get super specific and granular on this one thing that is working right now in cleaning companies to make more sales. And if you don't know, and it sounds like I'm just like this random person talking about how to run a cleaning company, I did have my own cleaning company. I sold that company. I had a successful exit, which I'm so proud of still to this day, still feels like a fever dream, honestly. I also do done-for-you services in cleaning companies literally to this day. I have a whole team that does done-for-you marketing, sales, and hiring for cleaning companies. So I'm always constantly testing and trying to make those campaigns as effective as possible. So anyway, with that being said, this is what's working. Affiliates. I know that some people feel a certain type of way about affiliates. And what I mean by affiliates is like influencers, partnering with influencers. But there is a very specific way that I like to partner with influencers for my clients, which are at this point cleaning companies. So when I'm looking for affiliates to partner with, I'm usually not going after the people who have like even 100,000 followers or more. Usually not the people that I am looking to partner with. I'm looking for the micro-influencers who are very local-based. I'm also making sure, obviously, and this probably goes without saying, but I'm making sure that whatever content they're posting aligns with my brand. So if they are posting us really negative and more they're like, I don't know, let's say they have like really explicit language all over their page, and that's just not quite the type of influencer. Like that's fine. Like I honestly cuss like a sailor, but not, you know, frontward facing on social media. So maybe that's just not the person that we want to align with on social media, and that's fine. So we're looking for people that do align in terms of our brand and our values. We're also looking like I actually do research on the influencers that I reach out to. So I'm looking at all of their recent posts, and by recent I mean like the last couple months, and I'm going to see does it actually make sense or would it be super random for us to create a video together? Okay, so I hope that gives you a little insight as to what I feel is working right now to get more leads. If you try to do this and you're running into any issues or you try it and you love it, I would love to know. And let me know if you want me to talk about sales because I know that's not a topic that I cover that much. So if you want me to talk more about what is working right now, sales related, let me know.
